Icecat.//: Product-content lookups used to fill in missing product images. Left blank here on purpose — put UserName/ApiKey in user-secrets, not in source control. With no UserName the client reports IsConfigured=false and enrichment simply does nothing.
Icecat.//EnrichmentEnabled: Lets the background worker fill in missing images. A finished feed sync signals it, so pressing Sync starts a pass immediately; with no Icecat UserName above the worker does nothing regardless. The manual POST api/Product/Catalog/EnrichImages endpoint works either way.
Icecat.//BatchPauseSeconds: Pause between batches while a backlog is draining — short, so a sync's new products are enriched in minutes, but not so short that Icecat is hammered.
Icecat.//IdleHours: Fallback sweep when no sync has signalled, for products added by any route other than a feed import.

FeedSecrets.//: Distributor feeds are defined in dbo.DistributorFeed and managed from /admin/feeds. No credential is ever stored here — this section only selects WHERE credentials are kept. Override per environment in appsettings.Development.json / appsettings.Production.json.
